overview: The paper proposes FreeAdapt, a plug-and-play framework that leverages diffusion priors for ultra-high-definition image restoration (UHD-IR) by introducing a training-free Frequency Feature Synergistic Guidance (FFSG) mechanism to resolve patch-based inconsistencies and an optional VAE fine-tuning module with skip connections to recover high-frequency details.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Loading Module
modules.description: Takes raw UHD-IR benchmark dataset paths as input and outputs preprocessed paired degraded-clean image tensors. Handles dataset-specific transformations, downsampling for reference generation, and patch cropping for VAE fine-tuning.

modules.name: Pre-trained LDM and VAE Initialization Module
modules.description: Takes model configuration and checkpoint paths as input and outputs initialized frozen/unfrozen components of the Latent Diffusion Model, including the VAE encoder, VAE decoder, U-Net, and text encoders.

modules.name: VAE Fine-Tuning Architecture Module
modules.description: Takes degraded image encoder features and clean latent representations as input and outputs enhanced decoded image features. Implements the modified VAE decoder integrated with parameter-efficient LoRA, Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN), and Zero-Convolution based skip connections.

modules.name: VAE Fine-Tuning Training Module
modules.description: Takes paired degraded-clean image batches and the modified VAE architecture as input and outputs updated decoder weights and loss values. Executes the training loop optimizing the composite loss function consisting of DWT-domain L2, LPIPS, SSIM, and GAN losses.

modules.name: Reference Image Generation Module
modules.description: Takes the degraded UHD input image as input and outputs a globally coherent reference latent representation. Processes the image by downsampling, performing a standard LDM denoising pass, upsampling, and re-encoding to establish low-frequency structural guidance.

modules.name: Frequency Guidance (FreqG) Module
modules.description: Takes the current noisy latent patch and the corresponding noised reference latent patch as input and outputs a phase-corrected latent patch. Transforms inputs to the frequency domain via FFT, fuses the phase spectrums using a dynamically shrinking low-pass filter, and reconstructs the latent via inverse FFT.

modules.name: Feature Guidance (FeatG) Module
modules.description: Takes local patch attention features (Query, Key, Value) and global reference attention features (Key, Value) as input and outputs blended attention feature maps. Computes local self-attention and global cross-attention, linearly fusing the results to suppress high-frequency hallucinations.

modules.name: Patch-Based Denoising Manager
modules.description: Takes full-resolution UHD latent representations as input and outputs individual patch tensors for denoising, or stitches denoised patch tensors back into a full-resolution latent. Handles patch cropping with overlap and smooth boundary blending.

modules.name: FreeAdapt Main Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Takes a degraded UHD image and pre-trained/fine-tuned models as input and outputs the restored UHD image. Orchestrates the complete inference workflow, integrating Reference Generation, Patch-Based Denoising, FreqG, FeatG, and final VAE decoding.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Module
modules.description: Takes restored images and corresponding ground-truth references as input and outputs a dictionary of quantitative quality scores. Computes full-reference metrics (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, DISTS) and no-reference perceptual metrics (CLIPIQA, MUSIQ, MANIQA).

modules.name: Ablation Study and Comparison Framework
modules.description: Takes experimental configuration flags and baseline model checkpoints as input and outputs performance logs and comparison tables. Systematically evaluates component contributions by toggling FreqG, FeatG, and VAE-FT, and benchmarks against other diffusion adaptation strategies.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Logging Infrastructure
modules.description: Takes raw YAML/JSON configuration files as input and outputs parsed experiment settings, tracked metrics, and saved checkpoints. Manages dataset variations, different diffusion backbones (LDM, StableSR, DiffBIR), and automated result aggregation.
